## Close attempt 1 REFUSED by the completion gate — store sync, not the work

Recording the refusal rather than working around it.

    rebar transition colourless-hasteless-lamb in_progress closed \
      --class env_integration --ref 565e1856bc9d180876fdbcaa336ccd57ceb8202e
    -> Error: the completion close gate refused to certify 5ec7-d681-9616-43ed: the local
       ticket store holds 6 committed ticket event(s) the shared store has never received
       (last delivery failure: final-push-rejected) (stale-store: push-pending)
    exit 1

The gate is right to decline: certifying against a store that is not current can read an
attestation as unsigned purely because the clone never received it.

Diagnosis (read-only): this is a PUSH RACE on the shared store, not corruption. `rebar fsck`
reported `PUSH_PENDING: local 'tickets' branch is ahead of origin/tickets by 7 commit(s)`, and the
store is the single shared clone at `/Users/joeoakhart/rebar/.tickets-tracker` — this worktree's
`.tickets-tracker` is a symlink to it, not a second clone. Sampling
`git rev-list --left-right --count tickets...origin/tickets` showed it moving between `0 0` and
`1 0` within seconds, with the newest commit belonging to another ticket entirely
(`e1d9-4c8e-3fd1-41c2`, another session's). Several agents are writing concurrently, so pushes race
and some are rejected, then retried on the next write. No divergence: the left/right counts never
showed remote-only commits.

Remedy taken: the documented one — perform a ticket write to retry the delivery (this comment),
then re-check `fsck` for `PUSH_PENDING` and re-run the close. No `--force`, no
`tracker-maintenance`, no raw git write to the tracker.
